svg.title: Lab 15: Private branch-to-cloud Inventory API
svg.desc: One GCP project in asia-southeast1. Branch and hub VPCs connect through two HA VPN tunnel pairs with Cloud Router BGP. A branch probe VM reaches private DNS and an internal Application Load Balancer, which routes to an IAM-protected Cloud Run Inventory API. Administrators use IAP only for SSH. Cloud Build publishes an image to Artifact Registry.
svg.text: Lab 15 — เชื่อมสำนักงานสาขากับ Inventory API แบบ Private
Regional private service • HA VPN + BGP • identity-aware access • controlled fault and recovery
No VM firewall rule to Cloud Run NEG
private-zone visibility only; not request traffic
Change prefix 10.70.1.0/24 only after approved request
